title: Sufi Movement
subject: History (CDS/NDA)

blocks.heading: ✨ The Sufi Movement
blocks.intro: The mystical movement within Islam, emphasizing direct union with God through love, music (Sama), and simple living.

blocks.heading: 1. Key Orders (Silsilas) in India
bullets: Suhrawardi Order: Founded by Shihabuddin Suhrawardi. Active in Punjab/Sindh. Accepted state offices, wealthy order.
Naqshbandi Order: Founded by Khwaja Bahauddin Naqshbandi. Most orthodox and conservative order. Opposed music and liberal policies of Akbar. Supported by Aurangzeb.

formulas: Chishti: Moinuddin (Ajmer Dargah) | Sama: Sufi music | Naqshbandi: Orthodox (Aurangzeb support)
